notes:
V3.0.2 — Wave 4 of V3: Google sign-in, email verification, Account tab.

DESKTOP
• 'Continue with Google' button on the login screen actually works now. Standard OAuth2 native-app flow — desktop opens your browser to Google, catches the redirect on a loopback port, hands the auth code to the APEX server for the actual token exchange (so the OAuth client_secret never ships with the installer).
• New ACCOUNT corner tab (⚇) between FRIENDS and TOOLS. Shows your username / email / display name / phone / verification status / Google-linked status, and lets you: edit display name + phone, change password, change email (re-verifies), and resend the verification email.

SERVER
• New endpoints: GET /auth/google/config, POST /auth/google/exchange, GET /auth/verify?token=…, POST /auth/resend-verification, PUT /auth/profile, PUT /auth/password, PUT /auth/email.
• Idempotent DB migration adds google_sub / is_verified / verification_token / verification_sent_at / avatar_url / phone columns to the users table.
• Email verification via Resend (free 3 000 sends/month). If RESEND_API_KEY isn't set, new signups are auto-verified so nobody gets stuck.
• Google OAuth needs GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID + GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET on the server. If unset, the desktop button cleanly surfaces 'not configured'.

SETUP (one-time, per server)
• Google console: APIs & Services → Credentials → OAuth client ID, type=Desktop app. No specific redirect URIs needed; Google accepts any 127.0.0.1:* loopback for desktop clients.
• Resend: sign up, add API key, optionally add a verified sending domain. Set RESEND_API_KEY + RESEND_FROM env vars on the server.
